product.name: Baserun AI Testing Platform
product.description: A collaborative platform for building, monitoring, and improving AI applications, focusing on prompt development, debugging, and evaluation.

product.name: Baserun Prompt Directory
product.description: A feature that manages, versions, evaluates, and deploys prompt templates through a user interface accessible to non-technical stakeholders.

product.name: Baserun Playground
product.description: An interactive environment for prototyping, testing, and iterating AI prompts and models with support for multiple models and prompt templates.

product.name: Baserun Evaluation and Monitoring
product.description: Tools for automatic and human evaluation of AI outputs, monitoring AI performance, and detecting issues in production environments.

product.name: Baserun SDKs and Integrations
product.description: Open-source SDKs for Python and Typescript that enable integration with any AI model or framework, including self-hosted deployment options.
